reason: The 'no effect' result relies on an unjustified restriction to the north region. The full sample with the same controls gives a positive, significant effect (0.75, SE 0.23, p=0.001). Central (0.81, p=0.04) and south (1.07, p=0.005) are also positive and significant. The north estimate (0.30, SE 0.40) has a wide CI that includes these values, so it cannot support 'no effect'. The report also mentions only one specification, so it does not show how sensitive the result is to the sample choice.
